title: Human-Robot Mutual Adaptation in Collaborative Tasks: Models and Experiments
venue: The International Journal of Robotics Research, 36(5–7), 618–634
one_sentence: mutual adaptation 的 computational foundation。你未来真正需要推进的是：
problem: 单向 robot adaptation 可能顺从人的次优策略，而坚持 designer-optimal goal 又可能损害 trust；Agent 需要估计 human adaptability 再决定顺从或引导。
method: MTurk video/UI collaborative table-carrying tasks，而非实体 co-manipulation。主要 between-subject study n=69，后续 repeated task n=43、hallway validation n=65、cross-task transfer n=58；离散 goals/actions，k=3 history，alpha grid，SARSOP planning；测 strategy choice、trust 与 team perceptions。
findings: Mutual 相比 Fixed trust 更高 U=180,p=.048，但 satisfaction 并非全面显著；57% Mutual participants 转向 robot optimal strategy vs Cross-training 26%。
k=1 pilot 约 23% oscillation，k=3 更符合 observations；initial trust 与 low self-confidence 预测首次 adaptation。
cross-task transfer 不完整，说明 task/social norm matter。
real_contribution: 把 mutual adaptation 操作化为 latent human-model inference 加 robot policy choice，展示 Agent 可在简化任务中主动引导而非只做 one-way personalization。
biggest_weakness: web/video UI、离散 designer-defined goals/modes；alpha 更像 compliance/strategy switching 而非 reciprocal co-learning。无 communicative meaning、repair、mutual belief 或 convention。
claim_boundary: 支持短时 constrained task-policy adaptation；不支持 embodied communication co-adaptation、partner-specific convention、common ground 或 long-term relationship。
